**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 16:02  
[FACT] User is looking for advice on selling an old electric guitar.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in tips on pricing and information to include in the listing for the guitar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Selling an old electric guitar can be a great way to declutter and make some extra cash.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for pricing the guitar fairly include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Research the guitar's make, model, and year on online marketplaces like Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, and Facebook Marketplace.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Consider the condition of the guitar when pricing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Think about the original price and depreciation over time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Set a competitive price with similar listings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for listing information include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Include clear photos of the guitar from multiple angles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Provide detailed descriptions including make, model, year, body and neck wood, electronics, hardware, upgrades, and condition.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Mention any accessories included in the sale.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Highlight unique features of the guitar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Be honest about any issues with the guitar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Set a clear title and description with relevant keywords.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Add a detailed specs list including neck width, scale length, and weight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Clean and prepare the guitar before listing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Be prepared to negotiate the price.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Consider getting an appraisal if unsure about the guitar's value.
